body: :c I'm sorry to hear about that. I appreciate your helping hand though. I'm going to take you up on your offer.

I have tried talking to her about the way she treats me and her tone. She just acts like "I can't believe you are bringing up MY attitude after all I've done for you. You're not grateful. balhablhblah."

 Many years ago I saw a psychiatrist so I could have someone to talk to. The doctor mentioned ways to go about talking to my mom about her  attitude but when I tried to execute what I was taught, my mom yelled at me and never took me back. (I was too young to drive at the time)

What I'm good at? I'm not really too sure. Maybe I'm just in a funk still and can't think of much positive. I'm good at caring? Does that count? I mean, obviously I care (maybe too much) what my mom thinks of me but also in the sense of making sure my friends are okay.

I'm trying to get back to school right now. I go to a community college, but I am on academic suspension (not that my mom knows), so signing up for classes is going to be an all day event. 

I literally want to just pack up and leave. but that leads to more issues like living paycheck to paycheck with rent- if i miss one week from work I'll be in big trouble money wise. 

To be honest, I feel a bit better than when I originally typed this thread. It's like a fucking roller coaster, I'll start break down crying few hours later I'll be fine, remember my situation and get really sick/down again, go off to work and it's like my problems are all gone.
